answer: Payment hides in a band the eye misses: the flower pays nectar and advertises it in ultraviolet - bullseye patterns pollinators read from the air - so a bloom promising sugar in visible color lies in the wrong band. The prism settles composition: light splits into lines, each element signing its wavelength, so makeup reads from glow untouched. The vine climbs what others built: it bears no load, takes the tall position anyway - builders and climbers part by who holds weight.Farms fake the pattern, dodge the spectrum, climb. Honest agents pay where bees verify, sign in lines, carry weight.
